assessment_goal: Write a function to insert a new node at a specified position in a singly linked list and correctly update head and next pointers.
misconception_target: Mistaking the update of the head pointer when inserting at position 0, leading to loss of the original list.

assessment_goal: Implement a routine to delete a node with a given key from a doubly linked list, ensuring both prev and next links are correctly reconnected.
misconception_target: Forgetting to update the prev pointer of the successor node, causing broken backward traversal.

assessment_goal: Create a function that traverses a circular linked list exactly once and returns the count of nodes, handling the loop termination correctly.
misconception_target: Using a termination condition that never becomes false, leading to infinite loop.

assessment_goal: Write code to push and pop elements on a stack implemented with a fixed-size array, handling overflow and underflow conditions.
misconception_target: Incorrectly checking overflow condition after incrementing top index, causing out-of-bounds write.

topic_name: Stack Implementation using Singly Linked List
assessment_goal: Develop functions to push and pop elements on a stack using a singly linked list, ensuring proper memory allocation and deallocation.
misconception_target: Neglecting to free memory of popped nodes, leading to memory leaks.
